description: The audit firehose, stacked by band. Signal is what the forensic dashboards show.

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL band = CASE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance"), "infra-noise", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "connection_granted", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "authentication_success", "authn-volume", "signal") | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY ts = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), band | EVAL band = CASE(band == "signal", "Signal", band == "authn-volume", "Auth success", band == "query-noise", "Query internals", "Infra health") | SORT ts ASC

transform.calculate: datum.ts_next ? toDate(datum.ts_next) : datum.ts_prev ? toDate(datum.ts) + (toDate(datum.ts) - toDate(datum.ts_prev)) : toDate(datum.ts) + 60000
